gloss: business trip expenses; travel expenses for work

definitions.gloss: business trip expenses; travel expenses for work
definitions.explanation: The total costs incurred when traveling for work, including transportation, accommodation, and daily allowances.

examples.japanese: {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To submit a claim for business trip expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出張費|しゅっちょうひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: This month's business trip expenses went over budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{出張費|しゅっちょうひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}えて→添える：13315_soeru⟧{一週間以内|いっしゅうかんいない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: According to company policy, business trip expenses must be settled within one week with receipts attached.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧ (business trip) and ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense; cost). Covers all costs associated with a business trip, including transportation (⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧), accommodation (⟦{宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}→宿泊費：25963_shukuhakuhi⟧), and per diem allowances (⟦{日当|にっとう}→日当：19259_nittou⟧). A standard term in Japanese workplace vocabulary, commonly appearing on expense reports and reimbursement forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to settle business trip expenses
- {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to file for business trip expenses
- {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧: expense limit for business trips
- {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧: business trip expense policy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧: transportation costs — a subcategory covering only travel fares
- ⟦{旅費|りょひ}→旅費：20646_ryohi⟧: travel expenses — a more general term that can apply to both business and personal travel
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧: expenses — a broader business term covering all operational costs
